headline: Congress summons Nvidia's CEO after report ties him to a Chinese intelligence recruit
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has been summoned by Congress amid concerns over Chinese espionage. Reports say China's intelligence agency recruited Megaspeed executive Alice Huang to gather information on American AI chips, and that US officials believe Huang was romantically involved with her as part of what is described as a honeypot operation. Lawmakers want answers about his ties to the alleged intelligence asset.
